title: stack/secrets.map.yaml
description: Which Bitwarden Secrets Manager secret fills which env var, per zone (spec §11.5). Values are bws secret ids, never secrets. `hapi secrets resolve` reads each id with `bws secret get` and writes $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/hapi/<zone>.env. See docs/secrets.md.

archon.description: The Archon container's env file (Pi runs in-process, so it sees these too).

research.description: The hapi-research container's env file: spend-capped, search-only keys (spec §10.1).

host.description: Host tools run by the hapi user (token minting, the harvester). Never a container's env file.

zone.description: Env var name -> bws secret id.

bwsId.description: A Bitwarden Secrets Manager secret id (a UUID). 00000000-0000-0000-0000-xxxxxxxxxxxx is a placeholder, refused at resolve time.
